title: Aromatic Crisp Malaysian Beef Noodles
description: A sweet and crispy Malaysian dish featuring beef and tomatoes, perfect for a sick day, and is egg-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onions to the skillet and cook until they are lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and oyster sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked beef back to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the beef and sauce.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions and a drizzle of sesame oil.
